purpose: Establish a longer 500k-row reference and IID diagnostic before data scaling; not a convergence claim or hyperparameter sweep.

budget.unit: 20 full epochs centrally or 20 full-participation rounds with one local epoch per client
budget.explanation: Client-specific batch tails change the aggregate update count; local Adam resets and aggregation also differ from centralized optimization.

evaluation.primary: Validation metrics in result.history[-1] at the fixed final budget
evaluation.secondary: Validation-best metrics in result.validation_metrics, selected by strict maximum macro-F1

entry_evidence.source: User-pasted cloud pilot checks and runtime summary; full artifacts not independently inspected locally
entry_evidence.purpose: Compatibility and recovery only; pilot metrics do not select settings for a sweep

execution.resume: After interruption, inspect status and last.pt; resume only the affected lane with identical settings and --resume. Do not rerun the entire block blindly.

next_gate.review: Inspect all three completed histories, final and best metrics, rare-class recall, false alerts and resource usage; preserve all runs.
next_gate.before_2m_5m: Implement and test the matched-update control, freeze evaluation opportunities and stopping policy, and verify larger packed cohorts before launching.
next_gate.confirmation: Use additional predefined seeds after the exploratory design is fixed; do not report this single seed as a robust winner.
